en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large youth brass and drum band posed in front of a building with a balcony. The children wear uniform-style clothing and caps, and many hold musical instruments (trombones, trumpets, drums, cymbals). A flag is held in the center of the group. At the bottom is handwritten or printed text in a Scandinavian language, and in the lower right corner is a dark label with the word "ARBEJDERMUSEET" and a small flag icon.
